server_url.description: Full HTTPS URL of your Nextcloud server (e.g., https://cloud.example.com). Required.

username.description: Username for basic authentication (ignored if OAuth is used).

password.description: Password for basic authentication (ignored if OAuth is used).

oauth_enabled.description: Enable OAuth 2.0 authentication instead of basic auth. Recommended for security.

oauth_client_id.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID registered with your Nextcloud instance.

oauth_client_secret.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret registered with your Nextcloud instance.

oauth_token_endpoint.description: Token endpoint URL (e.g., /index.php/apps/oauth2/api/v1/token). Leave blank to auto-detect.

oauth_authorize_endpoint.description: Authorization endpoint URL (e.g., /index.php/apps/oauth2/api/v1/authorize). Leave blank to auto-detect.

oauth_scopes.description: List of OAuth scopes to request (space-separated when rendered).

calendar_path.description: CalDAV path relative to server URL. Adjust if Nextcloud uses a custom path.

contacts_path.description: CardDAV path relative to server URL. Adjust if Nextcloud uses a custom path.

timeout.description: Connection timeout in seconds for HTTP requests to Nextcloud.

verify_ssl.description: Verify SSL/TLS certificates. Set to false only for testing with self-signed certs.
